evidence.excerpt: .env("NISSE_ALLOW_DIR_CREATION", "1"); for (key, value) in extra_env { if *value == "\u{0}remove" { command.env_remove(key); } else { command.env(key, value); } }

subject: integration test harness consent defaults
text: tests/integration/main.rs grants blanket directory-creation consent (NISSE_ALLOW_DIR_CREATION=1) to every spawned nisse binary by default; consent tests opt out by passing the sentinel value "\u{0}remove" which the harness translates to Command::env_remove.
